#!/bin/sh
set -e

echo "Starting OpenList as user $(id -u):$(id -g)..."

# Set umask if specified
if [ -n "$UMASK" ]; then
  umask "$UMASK"
fi

# Handle version command
if [ "$1" = "version" ]; then
  exec ./openlist version
fi

# Start aria2 if enabled
if [ "$RUN_ARIA2" = "true" ]; then
  echo "Starting aria2c in background..."
  aria2c \
    --enable-rpc \
    --rpc-allow-origin-all \
    --conf-path=/opt/aria2/.aria2/aria2.conf \
    >/dev/null 2>&1 &
fi

# Start OpenList server
echo "Starting OpenList server..."
exec ./openlist server --no-prefix

until mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "SELECT 1;" ; do
  echo "Waiting for MariaDB..."
  sleep 2
done
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`seafile_db\`;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`ccnet_db\`;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`seahub_db\`;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '$INIT_DB_PASSWORD';"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`seafile_db\`.* TO '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`ccnet_db\`.* TO '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
mariadb -h"$INIT_DB_HOST" -uroot -p"$INIT_DB_ROOT_PASSWORD" -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON \`seahub_db\`.* TO '$INIT_DB_USER'@'%'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"

# 切换external时取消注释
# url: https://{{ .Release.Name }}.${MAIN_DOMAIN}/api2/ping/

# 初始化指标文件
touch /tmp/metrics.txt

# 后台进程：定期更新指标
while true; do
  {
    echo "# HELP smb_mount_healthy SMB 挂载点是否健康 (1=健康, 0=不健康)"
    echo "# TYPE smb_mount_healthy gauge"

    for mount_info in \
      "sakamoto_media:/mnt/sakamoto-media" \
      "backup_media:/mnt/backup-media"
    do
      name="$${mount_info%%:*}"
      path="$${mount_info#*:}"

      if timeout 5 ls "$path" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "smb_mount_healthy{name=\"$name\",path=\"$path\",node=\"$NODE_NAME\"} 1"
      else
        echo "smb_mount_healthy{name=\"$name\",path=\"$path\",node=\"$NODE_NAME\"} 0"
      fi
    done
  } > /tmp/metrics.txt.new && mv /tmp/metrics.txt.new /tmp/metrics.txt

  sleep 30
done &

# HTTP 服务器提供指标 (前台运行 httpd)
httpd -f -p 9101 -h /tmp

rpk topic create lake.bronze.written --brokers=redpanda.streaming.svc.cluster.local:9093 -p 3 -r 1 || true
rpk topic create lake.silver.written --brokers=redpanda.streaming.svc.cluster.local:9093 -p 3 -r 1 || true
rpk topic create lake.articles.new --brokers=redpanda.streaming.svc.cluster.local:9093 -p 3 -r 1 || true

test -f /tooling/git-sync/current/ntool.py
mkdir -p /tooling/git-sync/current/lib/resources /tooling/project
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib
import pathlib
import urllib.request

target = pathlib.Path("/seeddb/seeddb.bin")
checkout_target = pathlib.Path("/tooling/git-sync/current/lib/resources/seeddb.bin")
expected = "ccdcea5e4465194158737462436ec10ae48669dd961902282ac2861e260d03c9"
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xxmichibxx/Batch-CIA-3DS-Decryptor-Redux/" \
    "main/bin/seeddb.bin"
data = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30).read()
if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != expected:
    raise SystemExit("seeddb.bin checksum mismatch")
target.write_bytes(data)
checkout_target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
checkout_target.write_bytes(data)
PY
cat > /tooling/project/pyproject.toml <<'EOF'
[project]
name = "romm-ntool-runtime"
version = "0.0.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"
dependencies = ["pycryptodome==3.23.0"]

[tool.uv]
package = false
EOF
uv lock --directory /tooling/project
uv sync --directory /tooling/project --locked
